glossary.definition: (1) "Employer" means a person who is required to withhold taxes out of payments of personal earnings made to a judgment debtor.
glossary.source_title: Section 2716.01 - Garnishing personal earnings or property of judgment debtor.

glossary.definition: (2) "Personal earnings" means money, or any other consideration or thing of value, that is paid or due to a person in exchange for work, labor, or personal services provided by the person to an employer.
glossary.source_title: Section 2716.01 - Garnishing personal earnings or property of judgment debtor.

glossary.definition: (3) "Judgment creditor" means a person who has obtained a judgment in a civil action against another person.
glossary.source_title: Section 2716.01 - Garnishing personal earnings or property of judgment debtor.

glossary.definition: (4) "Judgment debtor" means a person against whom a judgment has been obtained in a civil action.
glossary.source_title: Section 2716.01 - Garnishing personal earnings or property of judgment debtor.

glossary.definition: (5) "Support order" has the same meaning as in section 3119.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 2716.01 - Garnishing personal earnings or property of judgment debtor.
